## BFS — 02 Query

### How it works

1. Triggers when a webhook is received and sets a start time.
2. Classifies whether the request requires escalation or can be passed to AI.
3. Routes the request to the appropriate AI or escalation workflow.
4. Handles AI-generated responses or escalates them to the correct department.
5. Logs interactions and final responses are completed.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure webhook URL for the trigger node
- [ ] Set up OpenAI credentials for AI interactions
- [ ] Ensure Sub-workflows for Legal, HR, and Support are configured
- [ ] Set up Supabase connections for logging knowledge gaps
- [ ] Configure response limits and fallbacks

### Customization

Adjust AI models or routing logic based on specific needs or feedback.

## Webhook initiation

Begins workflow with a webhook and sets start time.

## Request classification

Determines if the request requires escalation or message passing.

## Escalation handling

Handles user-requested escalations and responses to them.

## Message routing

Sets the message for routing to the AI system.

## AI query response

Routes messages through AI and handles responses.

## Switch logic

Directs query to relevant department or handles fallback.

## Legal query processing

Handles legal queries via AI and logs interactions.

## HR query processing

Handles HR queries via AI and logs interactions.

## Support query processing

Handles support queries via AI and logs interactions.

## Fallback and escalation

Handles fallback responses and ambiguous escalations.

=Classify the following user message into exactly one category: 
legal, hr, support, or none.

- legal: contracts, policies, regulations, legal documents
- hr: employees, hiring, vacation, salary, work policy, remote work
- support: product questions, how-to, troubleshooting, pricing
- none: anything unrelated to the above categories

The message can be in any language. Classify based on the 
topic, not the language.

Also rate your confidence in this classification from 0.0 to 1.0.
Use a LOW confidence score (below 0.7) when the message could 
reasonably belong to more than one category (e.g. legal/hr overlap).

Respond with ONLY a JSON object, nothing else:
{"agent_type": "legal", "confidence": 0.95}
